$comment: Measured gate results. Every figure here was produced by running the named command against the frozen tree on the stated date — none is carried forward from a document. Regenerate by running the commands and updating this file; do not edit a number here without re-running its command.

gates.note: tsc -b then vite build. A bare `tsc --noEmit` against the root tsconfig checks zero files — see tsconfig.json.
Read from a pgoutput replication slot — the same protocol Supabase consumes. Skips explicitly, and reports SKIPPED rather than PASS, when wal_level is not logical.
Apple Silicon with WebGPU. A LOWER BOUND, not a mid-range-Android figure. No representative-hardware claim is made.

The mobile preset is the gated one and is BELOW the project's own >=90 performance gate, so the command exits non-zero. Accessibility 100 grades what is painted on the audited route; it is not proof that nothing fails. Full reports in lighthouse-feed-mobile.json and lighthouse-feed-desktop.json.

notProven: Nothing is deployed. The referenced Supabase project returns NXDOMAIN.
Storage uploads, Edge Function deployment, Auth flows and Realtime delivery are managed services with no local stand-in.
No classifier accuracy claim: the pipeline runs on a generic ImageNet-classed backbone, not a civic fine-tune.
Frame rate on a mid-range Android, the physical Add to Home Screen tap, and confirmation that the OS camera app opens.
